tools.name: fieldpulse_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers (name, email, phone, address, status, assigned user). GET /customers.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_customer_contacts
tools.description: The contacts (people) of one customer. GET /customers/{customerId}/customer-contact.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_customer_contact
tools.description: One contact of a customer. GET /customers/{customerId}/customer-contact/{contactId}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_jobs
tools.description: List or search jobs (type, status, customer, schedule, assignments), optionally within a created-at range or by custom status ids. GET /jobs.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_job
tools.description: One job by id, optionally with its custom field values. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_job_status_workflows
tools.description: The job status workflows (use their ids with fieldpulse_list_job_workflow_statuses and when setting a custom job status). GET /jobs/status-workflows.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_job_workflow_statuses
tools.description: The custom job statuses of all workflows, with their ids (for filtering jobs or setting a status). GET /jobs/status-workflow-statuses.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_estimates

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_estimate

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_invoices
tools.description: List or search invoices (customer, status, totals, due dates). GET /invoices.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_payments
tools.description: List or search payments (amount, method, date, invoice). GET /payments.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_payment
tools.description: One payment by id. GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_assets
tools.description: List or search customer assets (equipment) by install status. GET /assets.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_asset
tools.description: One asset by id. GET /assets/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_asset_categories
tools.description: List asset categories. GET /assets-category.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_locations
tools.description: List locations (service addresses) of a customer or a job. GET /locations.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_location
tools.description: One location by id. GET /locations/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_projects
tools.description: List or search projects (status, completion). GET /projects.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_project
tools.description: One project by id. GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_contracts
tools.description: List contracts (maintenance agreements). GET /contracts.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_contract
tools.description: One contract by id. GET /contracts/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_items
tools.description: List the invoice item catalog (products and services with prices). GET /items.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_item
tools.description: One invoice item by id. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders. GET /purchase-orders.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order by id. GET /purchase-orders/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers). GET /vendors.

tools.name: fieldpulse_get_vendor
tools.description: One vendor by id. GET /vendors/{id}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_company_profiles
tools.description: The company profile(s) of this FieldPulse account (name, address, contact details, settings). GET /company-profile.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_users
tools.description: List the account's users (team members) with ids for assignments. GET /users.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_teams
tools.description: List the account's teams. GET /teams.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_tags

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_lead_sources
tools.description: List customer lead sources. GET /lead-source.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_pipeline_statuses

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_subtasks
tools.description: List subtasks (job checklist items) by status or assigned user. GET /subtasks.

tools.name: fieldpulse_list_timesheets

tools.name: fieldpulse_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer (lead or account). Give first_name and/or last_name, or a unique display_name. Creates a new record every call; check fieldpulse_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. POST /customers.

tools.name: fieldpulse_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one customer (only the fields you pass). If FieldPulse asks for a name, include first_name/last_name or display_name. PUT /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: fieldpulse_create_job
tools.description: WRITE: create a job for an existing customer. Needs customer_id, job_type and the numeric billing value FieldPulse requires; set a status (1-6) or a custom status_id + status_workflow_id. Creates a new job every call. POST /jobs.

tools.name: fieldpulse_update_job
tools.description: WRITE: change a job: status, schedule, notes, assignments, location. FieldPulse requires customer_id, job_type and billing on every update, so this reads the job first and keeps those (and its current status) unless you pass new values. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fieldpulse_list_customers, fieldpulse_list_comments, fieldpulse_create_customer · Private data: fieldpulse_list_customer_contacts, fieldpulse_get_customer_contact, fieldpulse_list_company_profiles, fieldpulse_list_comments, fieldpulse_create_customer · Public sink: fieldpulse_list_customers, fieldpulse_create_customer, fieldpulse_create_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fieldpulse_list_customers, fieldpulse_list_comments, fieldpulse_create_customer · Private data: fieldpulse_list_customer_contacts, fieldpulse_get_customer_contact, fieldpulse_list_company_profiles, fieldpulse_list_comments, fieldpulse_create_customer · Public sink: fieldpulse_list_customers, fieldpulse_create_customer, fieldpulse_create_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
